name: typedash
description: Real-time multiplayer typing race with practice mode, daily challenge, ghost replays, share cards, seasons, teams, seven languages and worldwide rankings (Node.js + WebSockets, zero front-end build).

scripts.test: npm run test:typing && npm run test:race && npm run test:auth && npm run test:cx && npm run test:rank && npm run test:solo && npm run test:daily && npm run test:lock && npm run test:ghost && npm run test:share && npm run test:pages && npm run test:seasons && npm run test:teams && npm run test:lang && npm run test:push && npm run test:limits && npm run test:browser && npm run test:mobile && npm run test:embed
scripts.test:race: RANK_GUESTS=1 DATA_FILE=/tmp/typedash-test/race.json LOBBY_WAIT_MS=1500 COUNTDOWN_MS=1200 RESULTS_MS=1500 AFTER_FIRST_FINISH_MS=4000 node test/run-test.js
scripts.test:share: RANK_GUESTS=1 PRACTICE_LOCK=0 NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 DATA_FILE=/tmp/typedash-test/share.json node test/run-share-test.js
scripts.test:pages: RANK_GUESTS=1 PRACTICE_LOCK=0 NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 DATA_FILE=/tmp/typedash-test/pages.json node test/run-pages-test.js
